fusions.name: Scolding Spit
fusions.desc: Spits drawn venom at the first enemy in line for 11 damage, leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds, and your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for each ally beside you, up to 32%.

fusions.name: Drawing the Venom
fusions.desc: Pecks every one of your afflictions out of the target and deals 18 damage, plus 1.2 times their remaining damage, and 60% more for each affliction it uses up.

fusions.name: Bitter Preening
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 poison conditions from you and every ally.

fusions.name: Scorpion Eater
fusions.desc: When your health falls below half, healing you receive rises by 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds. You carry 10% poison resistance.
